commits.author: Dan Stupka
commits.subject: Add Fusion Gen3 as a deliberately small AMSRE + Doc-UFCN arbitration layer: it pins the authoritative AMSRE (21ea516c3c5a) and Doc-UFCN (595002645fcc) winners, keeps AMSRE primary, and allows Doc-UFCN only as a confidence-gated rescue when AMSRE score is weak and the geometries materially disagree. Gen3 reuses the Doc-UFCN lifecycle and precomputed evidence, exposes only 210 arbitration combinations, and is wired into the registry, regression/optimizer dropdowns, reporting characterization, and debug output.

commits.author: Dan Stupka
commits.subject: Refined `scantailor_page_frame` to a focused 54-point two-dimensional calibration around the current 0.075 boundary-margin / 0.003 projection-smoothing winner. The four characterized low/zombie dimensions are pinned to the winning values while the detector's true baseline remains preserved as the mandatory reference; tests now lock the 0.065–0.085 margin sweep, 0.002–0.0045 smoothing sweep, and frozen values. Targeted ScanTailor and regression-space tests pass.
